name: TheDawn

components.pose: Medium, surging ascent: she rises upright on a heaving pillar of stone and earth, one arm raised high and the other out to her side, weight planted, chin lifted and gaze to the camera, fierce and proud; full figure from head to toe visible above the rubble.
components.headwear: a feather crown with a {{METAL}} headband set with {{ACCENT_SOFT}} beads
components.jewelry: layered {{ACCENT_SOFT}} bead necklaces with bone and {{METAL}} talismans, heavy {{METAL}} cuffs, feather earrings
components.effects: Boulders, slabs and clouds of red dust fall back down around her in slow arcs, sparks of {{MAGIC}} light running through the cracks in the ground, gold sunlight cutting through the dust.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
